label: Longitudinal association of mental-health problems with subsequent diagnosis of persistent somatic symptom disorders: A large-scale registry-based observational study in primary care.
summary: Somatic symptoms of common persistent somatic symptom (PSS) syndromes like irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS), and fibromyalgia (FM) are not fully attributed to well-established biomedical pathological processes. These syndromes are often under-recognized and diagnosis is often delayed.
